facts.fact: ANP reports that on 11 March 2026 the ICT minister opened the validation workshop for the PNDN 2026-2035 and the Plan Sectoriel de Développement du Numérique 2026-2030, the text being "soumise aux participants pour validation"; the headline says Niger "entend se doter" of the policy and no adopting act or body is named.
facts.system: Politique Nationale de Développement du Numérique (PNDN) 2026-2035

facts.fact: The article names a Plan Sectoriel de Développement du Numérique 2026-2030 submitted with the policy, whose "actions prévues" the workshop was to enrich; it gives no cost.
facts.system: Politique Nationale de Développement du Numérique (PNDN) 2026-2035

facts.fact: The validation workshop for the PNDN 2026-2035 opened officially on 11 March 2026.

systems.tiers: Described as a lever for economic and social transformation: fibre-interconnection hub, e-government, rural connectivity, financial inclusion, local content and start-ups; three axes (governance and security, infrastructure and services, skills and innovation); implementation to rest on an institutional mechanism for coordination, steering and monitoring-evaluation (no body named). The Government is said to give digital development a central place.
